scope: Retrospective internal benchmark and research support software; no real new-ingredient or external validation
interpretation: Judge sensitivity and specificity levels together, with MCC/AUC as complementary evidence; no single-metric winner
preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only to training rows for linear models. No imputation or outcome-driven feature selection.

representation_comparison.retrospective_status: Original data and baseline outcomes have already been inspected. This is not an untouched external test.
representation_comparison.supplier_scenario: Train and evaluate a separate feature scenario, never overwrite source values

onboarding.materials: all 18, report failures and all results
onboarding.selection: Nested random order of complete ingredient-combination groups, fixed before prediction and without outcome-based search
onboarding.test_lock: Same new-material test and old-material retention sets across all budgets and features within ingredient/seed
onboarding.batches: Not reported in source; independence across manufacturing batches remains unresolved

selective_prediction.threshold_selection: All fixed in advance; no best cutoff selected from outer OOF

reporting.uncertainty: Repeat SD is not a confidence interval. Across-material results overlap in formulations; no independence or significance claims.
reporting.primary_summary: Report per-material means over seeds and equal-weight descriptive means; include all per-split counts and uncomputable metrics
